scope: Complete standalone generated public Boolean systems only. No curve inputs, imported targets, scalar recovery, production solver integration, IC or rho campaign.
fixtures: n+2 equations, twelve distinct quadratic monomials and up to four linear monomials per equation. Planted families choose constants to satisfy a public reproducible Boolean witness that is never passed to the solver. Cross-planted makes a pair differ by a valid affine consequence. Unplanted constants are independent; its status is established by complete search when available. No fixture screening.
ordering: Seven repetitions per fixture. For zero-based fixture index c, rotate first arm by 7*c modulo 28, then increment by one each repetition. Over 36 fixtures at each size this visits every arm position nine times. This is balance over the full size cohort, not balance within each individual fixture. Timing is paired within fixture and repetition.
final_gate: At every n16/20/24 and every family in both regression and holdout splits require the 95 percent paired-bootstrap lower bound above 2.0 against the pointwise fastest of the fixed reference roster. All 18 groups and every 144-cell completion/verification must pass. A separate incremental threshold is 1.0 and matched-policy threshold is 1.05. None substitutes for the dramatic gate. No tuning after holdout timing. Any passing selected candidate requires unchanged-source confirmation on unused holdouts.
accounting: All source-system compilation, projected-rank certification, failed certificates and full affine extraction, map construction, coefficient transformation, block setup/updates, enumeration, model recovery, context destruction and independent result checks are charged inside cold arm totals. Phase costs are exclusive subsets. Logical projection rows and reduction XORs are explicit; kernel_calls/source_rows/source_columns include the 64-column projection and the full reduction when needed. Candidate-specific memory and calibrated operations remain unmeasured. Original reference preparation, fixture generation and record formatting are included only in process receipts.
correctness: All retained controls remain in the same binary. Scalar/native transported blocks must preserve original Gray models, work and checksums, including hybrid prefixes. Initial list and optimized policies must match their recovered original models, all logical counters and checksums. Every SAT model is checked on original equations and UNSAT requires the completed retained search reference. UNKNOWN is censored. The exact 64-coordinate linear projection certifies only full quadratic row rank; any failure takes complete original-row-space affine extraction. No ideal multiplication closure or probabilistic rank assumption is used.
selection: resource_probe_01 retains the slower full-vector-difference implementation; resource_probe_02 tests scalar factoring and an exact projected-rank certificate. Both use only discovery seeds 17 and 937 at n16/n24. Prior unstarted confirmation seeds are left unused. The complete predecessor 120-system grid, including every failure, is retained and 24 fresh systems are added.
